tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sprawls on a low wooden deck chair, one leg hooked over the armrest while it flips through a paperback held above its face, other palm pressed flat on the deck for balance.
tasks.camera: three-quarter overhead view looking down the length of the chair
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully in frame; the paperback hand shows all fingers clear of the cover edge
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在躺椅上看书，一手撑地保持平衡

tasks.instruction: Lying on its back across a wide beanbag, the blue tiger balances a spinning basketball on one raised foot sole while both palms rest open beside its head, gaze fixed upward.
tasks.camera: low frontal shot from foot level looking up the body
tasks.visibility_requirement: The balancing sole is fully toward camera with all four toes and pad visible; the other foot is off-frame or hidden
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧豆袋上，用脚掌顶转篮球

tasks.instruction: Reclining sideways on a park bench, the blue tiger extends one arm to feed crumbs to a pigeon perched on the bench back, palm turned up and open while its other hand props its chin.
tasks.camera: eye-level side profile framing the extended arm and bird
tasks.visibility_requirement: The feeding palm is fully open toward camera with five distinct fingers; chin hand visible but secondary
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺长椅上摊开手掌喂鸽子

tasks.instruction: Flat on its stomach on a gym mat, the blue tiger props itself on both elbows and threads a needle with a bright thread, tongue slightly out in concentration, elbows sinking into the mat.
tasks.camera: close top-down shot over the shoulders onto the hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands and all fingers gripping needle and thread must be unobstructed
tasks.intent_zh: 趴垫子上用手肘撑起，穿针引线

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its side on a rug, one sole planted flat against an upright book to keep it from sliding, while its upper hand traces a route on an unfolded map.
tasks.camera: slightly elevated three-quarter view along the body toward the book
tasks.visibility_requirement: The bracing sole faces camera with pad and four toes clear; the map hand fully visible
tasks.intent_zh: 侧卧地毯上脚掌抵住书本，手在地图上描路线

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a hammock strung between palms, the blue tiger reaches up to clip a lantern onto the rope above, one leg dangling with its sole turned toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: low angle from below the hammock looking up
tasks.visibility_requirement: The clipping hand shows five fingers around the carabiner; dangling sole fully toward camera
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在吊床上抬手挂灯笼，脚掌朝向镜头

tasks.instruction: On its back under a motorcycle, the blue tiger slides out from beneath it, one palm braced on the floor and a wrench in the other hand, legs bent with knees up.
tasks.camera: ground-level worm's-eye view from beside the front wheel
tasks.visibility_requirement: Bracing palm spread flat and visible; wrench hand's fingers all visible around the handle
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺在摩托车下修车，一手撑地一手握扳手

tasks.instruction: Lying propped on one hip on a chaise, the blue tiger holds a teacup aloft in a three-finger grip and balances a saucer flat on its raised knee, pinky extended.
tasks.camera: medium frontal shot slightly to one side, teacup near center
tasks.visibility_requirement: The teacup hand shows exactly five fingers with clear separation; saucer hand visible
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺躺椅上三指捏茶杯，膝盖顶着茶碟

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sprawls belly-down on a rooftop ledge, chin over the edge, one hand shading its eyes and the other dangling straight down pointing at the street below.
tasks.camera: high angle looking down past the character to the street
tasks.visibility_requirement: The pointing hand shows five fingers straight and spread; shading hand visible at brow
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在屋顶边缘向下指街道

tasks.instruction: Reclining in a canvas camping chair, the blue tiger threads a fishing line through a hook, holding the hook steady with its left hand while the right pinches the line.
tasks.camera: close two-shot centered on the hands and hook, chair visible at edges
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands fully unobstructed with all ten fingers countable around hook and line
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在露营椅上把鱼线穿进鱼钩

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its back in bed with knees drawn up, holding a book upright on its own raised soles while a reading lamp clips to the headboard above.
tasks.camera: side view at mattress height, showing the book resting on the soles
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles face camera bracing the book, pads and four toes each clear; one hand steadying the book visible
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧床上用两只脚掌撑住书阅读

tasks.instruction: Stretched out on a picnic blanket, the blue tiger arches back to drop a grape into its own mouth from a raised hand, the other arm flung wide with palm open on the grass.
tasks.camera: profile framing from ground level, grape hand near the mouth
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms face camera at some angle with all fingers visible; grape held at fingertips
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在野餐垫上仰头把葡萄丢进嘴里

tasks.instruction: Sprawled diagonally across a hotel bed, the blue tiger holds a tablet overhead and jabs at the screen with one index finger, toes of one foot splayed and visible over the mattress edge.
tasks.camera: three-quarter view from the foot of the bed, screen angled away
tasks.visibility_requirement: Tablet hand with pointing finger fully visible; over-edge sole shows pad and four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 斜躺床上举平板戳屏幕，脚掌露出床沿

tasks.instruction: Lying on its side on a yoga mat, the blue tiger extends both arms overhead in a long stretch, palms flat together, feet flexed with soles angled toward the mat.
tasks.camera: top-down full-body shot centered on the diagonal
tasks.visibility_requirement: Joined palms fully shown from above, five fingers each; no appendage cut off
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺瑜伽垫上双臂上举合掌伸展

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lounges on a cargo net strung above a boat deck, one leg hooked through a square of rope and one hand waving a signal flag in a wide arc, the other holding the net edge.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter angle from the deck up toward the net
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flag hand's fingers wrap the pole visibly; net-edge hand shows all fingers gripping rope
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在货网上单手挥舞信号旗

tasks.instruction: Half-reclined against a tree trunk, the blue tiger squeezes a juice box with both hands until a thin arc squirts out, head tilted back and laughing, one knee bent up.
tasks.camera: front medium shot at seated eye level
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands crushed around the box with all ten fingers distinctly visible
tasks.intent_zh: 靠树干半躺，双手挤果汁盒喷出弧线

tasks.instruction: On its stomach on a skateboard, the blue tiger pushes itself along a ramp with both palms slapping the concrete, legs trailing straight behind, one sole visible lifted at the tail.
tasks.camera: low rear three-quarter tracking view along the board
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both pushing palms flat and open toward camera; lifted sole shows pad and four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 趴滑板上双手撑地滑行，抬起一只脚掌

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines inside a giant tire swing, knees up, holding a harmonica to its mouth with one hand while the other taps a rhythm on the tire's inner wall.
tasks.camera: framed head-on through the tire opening
tasks.visibility_requirement: Harmonica hand shows five fingers cupping it; tapping hand visible against rubber
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在轮胎秋千内吹口琴，另一手打拍子

tasks.instruction: Lying on its back on a workshop creeper, the blue tiger reaches up to tighten a bolt overhead with a socket wrench, the other palm flat on the floor for leverage, knees bent.
tasks.camera: side profile at creeper height, wrench arm raised into frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Wrench hand's fingers wrap the handle with all five visible; floor palm fully open
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在修车板上向上拧螺栓，一手撑地

tasks.instruction: Curled on a window seat with rain outside, the blue tiger holds a steaming mug against its chest and wipes condensation from the glass with the flat of its other palm.
tasks.camera: interior side shot with the rainy window behind the character
tasks.visibility_requirement: Wiping palm pressed flat to glass, all fingers splayed and visible; mug hand visible
tasks.intent_zh: 蜷在窗台，一手捧杯一手抹玻璃水汽

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on a low wall with both feet propped against a signpost, drumming its soles alternately against the metal while tossing an apple from hand to hand above its chest.
tasks.camera: low angle from below the wall, soles and apple hands in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles face camera pressing the post, pads and four toes clear; apple-tossing hands fully shown
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在矮墙上双脚踩踏路牌，双手抛苹果

tasks.instruction: Reclining on a massage table, the blue tiger has one arm folded behind its head and the other hand clenched into a fist being examined, knuckles toward camera.
tasks.camera: close frontal shot centered on the raised fist
tasks.visibility_requirement: Fist hand fully toward camera with all five fingers curled distinctly; folded arm visible
tasks.intent_zh: 躺按摩床上举起握拳的手端详

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger sprawls across a large floor cushion stacking playing cards into a tower, one hand steadying the tower base and the other carefully placing the top card.
tasks.camera: low table-level shot looking across the card tower to the character
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both hands at the tower with fingers individually visible, none hidden behind cards
tasks.intent_zh: 躺坐垫上双手搭扑克牌塔

tasks.instruction: Lying on its side on a sailboat deck, the blue tiger hauls a rope in with both hands, heels braced against a cleat, one sole turned up toward the camera.
tasks.camera: low deck-level angle along the rope toward the braced feet
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both rope-gripping hands show five fingers each; braced sole faces camera with pad and toes
tasks.intent_zh: 侧躺甲板上双手拉绳，脚掌抵住系缆桩

tasks.instruction: Flat on its back on a trampoline, the blue tiger presses both soles flat against the underside of a hovering drone, pretending to hold it up, while both palms lie open at its sides.
tasks.camera: top-down shot through the trampoline frame onto soles and drone
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles flat against the drone with pads and four toes each fully visible; open palms countable
tasks.intent_zh: 仰卧蹦床上双脚托住无人机

tasks.instruction: Reclining in a bathtub full of bubbles, the blue tiger balances a rubber duck on one raised knee and flicks water at it with its fingers, other hand behind its head.
tasks.camera: slightly elevated frontal shot across the tub rim
tasks.visibility_requirement: Flicking hand with fingers mid-snap fully visible clear of bubbles; head hand visible
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在泡泡浴缸里用手指弹水花逗橡皮鸭

tasks.instruction: Lying on a dune with feet downhill, the blue tiger holds a kite string taut overhead in one fist while its open palm scoops sand and lets it stream away on the wind.
tasks.camera: low angle from downhill looking up the slope past the character
tasks.visibility_requirement: Open scooping palm tilted toward camera with five fingers visible; kite fist visible against sky
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在沙丘上放风筝，另一手舀沙任风吹走

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger lies on its stomach across two stacked crates, threading a lace through a boot with both hands, one sole raised behind it angled toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: rear three-quarter view over the shoulder onto hands and raised sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both lacing hands with all fingers visible around lace and boot; raised sole shows pad and four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 趴在木箱上双手系鞋带，后方脚掌朝向镜头

tasks.instruction: Sprawled on a chaise with a laptop on its stomach, the blue tiger pushes the screen back with one flat palm while typing one-handed with the other, face lit by the glow.
tasks.camera: front three-quarter view from above the screen's back edge
tasks.visibility_requirement: Pushing palm flat and open on the lid fully visible; typing hand's fingers clear on the keyboard
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在躺椅上单手打字，一手推笔记本屏幕

tasks.instruction: The blue tiger reclines on a pool float, one foot lifted dripping above the water while it inspects its own sole pad with both hands, toes spread wide.
tasks.camera: close low angle from water level toward the raised foot and hands
tasks.visibility_requirement: Raised sole toward camera with pad and four toes unobstructed; both hands steadying the foot with fingers visible
tasks.intent_zh: 躺在浮床上抬起脚掌，双手检查脚底肉垫
